Definition: Tikvah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Tikvath or Tikvah = "hope"; 1) father of Shallum, the husband of the prophetess Huldah in the time of king Josiah of Judah; 2) father of Jahaziah (Tikvah) in the time of Ezra
